_about: Real Indian health insurance policy wordings, published by the insurers themselves. Only the address and a fingerprint of each is committed - never the document, which belongs to the insurer. Fetch with: python evals/real/fetch_policies.py

policies.why_chosen: IRDAI's standard product: every insurer must sell it with the same terms, so this wording is the closest thing to a common baseline.
A retail product from a standalone health insurer, typeset differently from the standard product.
A large retail product from a general insurer: the longest of the three, and the hardest test of whether a whole policy fits in one prompt.
